findingDetails.title: Moved shipped-path harness skips when required dist output is absent
findingDetails.evidence: The shipped-path test returns after recording SKIP when anchor-generator.js is missing, so an absent compiled output does not fail the legacy harness.
findingDetails.recommendation: Make required shipped-path assertions fail or gate the skip on an explicitly unprovisioned environment.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct read of the harness plus source/dist alignment and freshness consumers.

findingDetails.title: Embeddings harness retains scripts naming in comments and variables
findingDetails.evidence: The moved harness uses current relative path resolution but still describes the package as the scripts workspace.
findingDetails.recommendation: Refresh comments and local naming when the harness is next edited.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct read of the harness and current package topology.

results.summary: The moved dist target is current, but the legacy harness can skip missing output.
The packet records verification but the harness behavior cannot be replayed here.

noveltyJustification: Source/dist wiring is current; the new issue is the legacy harness's skip behavior when output is absent.
